title: Studio Records tab: deleting a published field that holds rows is refused with 409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE and the pillar offers no way to confirm
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziunkXbDT7wUWqfmWz

Out-of-scope finding from PR #34926 (card #34794, epic #34571), observed live by its dev and confirmed as a needed carrier in L1 comment 6954262589. It predates that PR: the field-removal save path is unchanged there.

## What happens

Studio, Records tab of a published object, zh-CN, 1280 px. Delete a field that already holds rows (header `···` > 删除 > confirm).

- The field leaves the grid at once.
- The draft save answers `409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` ("re-submit with `?force=true`").
- The pillar shows only its generic 更改未保存 banner. It does not say that the server refused because data would be lost, and it offers no way to confirm and force the save. The user is left with a draft that cannot be saved and no explanation.

## What the code reads (origin/main)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` judges only `METADATA_CONFLICT` on the draft save (`errorCodeIs(e, 'METADATA_CONFLICT')`); no `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` branch and no forced retry.
- Other editors already handle this refusal: `ResourceEditPage.tsx` (confirmation listing what the server said would be lost, then a forced retry), `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, and `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` (#27458). The Studio data pillar is the one save path left without it.

## Expected

On `409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` the pillar names what would be lost (from the refusal's `issues`) and offers a confirm that retries with `force`, or a cancel that keeps the field. Same pattern as the editors above.

Related closed precedents: #27458, #24411, #23480.
